scripts.build: node scripts/build-metadata.cjs && node scripts/build-code-tools.cjs && npm run minify-js && npm run minify-css
scripts.minify-js: terser vendor/codemirror.min.js vendor/prettier-html.min.js src/xoditor.js src/xoditor-enhancements.js -o dist/xoditor.min.js -c -m --comments '/^!/' && node scripts/release-banner.cjs
scripts.minify-css: cleancss -o dist/xoditor.min.css vendor/codemirror.css src/xoditor.css src/xoditor-enhancements.css && node scripts/release-banner.cjs css
scripts.verify: npm run build && node scripts/deploy-gwp.cjs && npm run check && npm run test:all
